exercises.question: Which sentence clearly introduces an opinion and a reason?
options: Creo que esta propuesta es útil porque responde a un problema real. [I think this proposal is useful because it responds to a real problem.]
Creo que esta propuesta es muy útil para mucha gente de la ciudad. [I think this proposal is very useful for many people in the city.]
Esta propuesta responde a un problema real que afecta a muchas personas. [This proposal responds to a real problem that affects many people.]

exercises.sentence: Desde mi __ de vista, la medida debería cambiar.
exercises.english: From my point of view, the measure should change.
It seems to me that this position is reasonable, although it needs more evidence.

sentences: Primero, hablamos de la propuesta. [First, we talk about the proposal.]
Después, digo: creo que es útil porque responde a un problema real. [Then I say: I think it is useful because it responds to a real problem.]
Finalmente, pido otras opiniones. [Finally, I ask for other opinions.]

exercises.question: Which expression means «point of view»?
options: punto de vista [point of view]
punto final [full stop]
fin de semana [weekend]

exercises.sentence: Yo __ que debemos escuchar otros puntos de vista.
exercises.english: I consider that we should listen to other points of view.
I consider that we should listen to other points of view before deciding.

exercises.sentence: Me parece que esta postura es razonable, aunque necesita más evidencia.
options: The position seems reasonable, although it needs more evidence.
The position was rejected, although it had enough evidence.
The evidence seems reasonable, although it needs a better position.

exercises.sentence: Desde mi punto de vista, la medida debería cambiar.
options: From my point of view, the measure should change.
From my point of view, the measure has disappeared.
The measure cannot change.

exercises.sentence: Considero que debemos escuchar otros puntos de vista antes de decidir.
exercises.english: I believe we should listen to other points of view before deciding.

prompt.speaker: A
prompt.text: ¿Cuál es tu postura sobre la propuesta?

options: Desde mi punto de vista, es útil porque responde a un problema real. [From my point of view, it is useful because it responds to a real problem.]
Desde mi punto de vista, sea útil porque responde a un problema real. [From my point of view, it be useful because it responds to a real problem.]
Desde mi punto de vista, la reunión es a las cinco de la tarde. [From my point of view, the meeting is at five in the afternoon.]
Creo que necesitamos más evidencia antes de decidir. [I think we need more evidence before deciding.]
Creo que necesitemos más evidencia antes de decidir. [I think we need (subjunctive) more evidence before deciding.]
Creo que el lunes es un día largo para los estudiantes. [I think Monday is a long day for students.]
Me parece que es razonable, aunque tiene algunas limitaciones. [It seems to me that it is reasonable, although it has some limitations.]
Me parece que sea razonable, aunque tiene algunas limitaciones. [It seems to me that it be reasonable, although it has some limitations.]
Me parece que mañana es el examen, aunque tiene algunas limitaciones. [It seems to me that tomorrow is the exam, although it has some limitations.]

template.prompt: State an opinion and give one reason.
template.answer: Creo que esta propuesta es útil porque responde a un problema real.

template.prompt: State a qualified opinion about two options.
template.answer: Desde mi punto de vista, la primera opción es razonable, aunque la segunda podría ser más eficaz.
